verdicts.reason: Both break the reading order the same way: the 'SUBSCRIBE & SAVE' eyebrow is moved below the legal line next to the CTA, the headline is tiny for a 768px square while the badge dominates, and a large empty band is left at the bottom. A at least keeps the headline, body and eyebrow on one left edge, though its CTA floats short of the right margin. B is more ragged: the text column starts at x≈80, the eyebrow floats at an unrelated x≈177, the CTA sits at another arbitrary x, and the oversized badge dwarfs the message even more.
